event.description:
Join us for organized play of Grand Archive, an anime-inspired TCG! Bring your own deck (or grab a starter set at the cafe) and test your skills in a 3-round Swiss tournament, all while enjoying food, snacks, and craft beverages in a comfortable, relaxed setting. Players of all skill levels are welcome! 

Entry: $12 Includes 1 event pack for participation.
Prizing: $6 store credit per win ($3 for a draw) plus 1 event pack per win
event.name: Grand Archive at VPC
